_about: Package set for Lesson 19. One real package plus one optional add-on. Prices in the worked example are teaching inputs, not market data.

packages.name: Enquiry Response System for Lumen Med Spa
packages.outcome: Every new enquiry answered within minutes, qualified, and offered a booking slot
packages.price_note: WORKED EXAMPLE price: set from your Lesson 00 baseline and Lesson 14 cost floor. Change it to yours before quoting anyone.
inclusions: Intake form connected to Instagram DMs and the website form
Qualification questions and booking link handover
Follow-up sequence for enquiries that go quiet
Weekly summary of enquiries, bookings, and unanswered questions
exclusions: No rewrite of the full website
No out of hours human phone cover
packages.support_window: 14 days of fixes for defects in the delivered scope after handover

packages.name: Add-on: Second Location Setup
packages.outcome: The same system configured for a second Lumen Med Spa location
packages.price_note: WORKED EXAMPLE add-on: priced only as an addition to the main package, never sold alone.
inclusions: Location specific hours, services, and booking link
Separate weekly summary for the location
exclusions: No new qualification logic beyond the main package
packages.support_window: Covered by the main package support window
